title: U.S. Foes React to the GOP’s Midterm Wipeout
gist: After the GOP's 2026 midterm wipeout, which Vance attributed partly to the Iran war's economic toll, Iran gloated but expects no U.S. policy shift, the Kremlin hopes Trump keeps easing pressure on Moscow ahead of Abu Dhabi talks, and China stayed scripted before a planned Trump-Xi meeting in Shenzhen. Also: Trump weighs whether to end the Iran war or escalate, Hegseth faces possible impeachment, and 40 of 41 local data center restriction measures passed.

insights.claim: According to Haltiwanger and Iyengar, the Iran war's economic impact played a significant role in turning U.S. voters against Republicans in the 2026 midterms, a point even Vice President J.D. Vance acknowledged.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: War-driven economic pain (energy prices) is now a proven electoral liability, which pressures the White House to de-escalate.
insights.quote: the Iran war’s economic impact played a significant role in turning voters against Republicans nationwide
insights.locator: He’s right. As even U.S. Vice

insights.claim: Iranian parliamentary speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf framed the GOP defeat as American voters rejecting Trump's war against Iran.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Tehran reads the vote as domestic constraint on Washington, which may stiffen its bargaining stance.
insights.quote: Americans said NO TO WAR, and we endorse this message

insights.claim: Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei signaled that Tehran does not expect U.S. hostility to change because Democrats will control Congress, and warned against making concessions.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Low odds of a quick Iranian concession; negotiated de-escalation depends on Trump's choice rather than on Congress.

insights.claim: The U.S. carried out limited strikes on Iran before the midterms while Trump pledged no major escalation until after the vote, and it is unclear whether he will now end the war or launch a fresh military operation to save face.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: A binary escalation risk after the election; key driver for oil prices and Gulf risk premia.
insights.quote: it’s still unclear whether he’ll move to cut his losses and end the war or try to save face with a fresh military operation
insights.locator: Though the U.S. carried out limited

insights.claim: Mediators such as Qatar are trying to restart Tehran-Washington talks to reach a deal and prevent another round of heavy fighting.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Progress in Qatar-mediated talks would be a de-escalation signal for energy markets.
insights.locator: Though the U.S. carried out limited

insights.claim: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who also faces a possible loss of power, has reportedly pressed Trump to return to war with Iran, but most Americans now view the Israeli government unfavorably and bipartisan support for reassessing U.S.-Israel ties is growing.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Shifting U.S. opinion on Israel lowers the political payoff of renewed escalation.

insights.claim: The United States is set to mediate trilateral Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi on Nov. 10, as Trump has again soured on supporting Kyiv while reducing financial constraints on Moscow.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Sanctions easing on Russia could affect Russian commodity flows; watch the talks' outcome.
insights.quote: the president has once again soured on continued support for Kyiv while moving to reduce financial constraints on Moscow

insights.claim: The Kremlin, through spokesperson Dmitry Peskov, expressed hope that Trump will continue his current peace approach, even as a Democratic Congress is poised to push for stronger U.S. backing of Ukraine.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Divergence between Congress and the White House on Ukraine raises policy uncertainty on sanctions and aid.
insights.quote: President Trump remains in office. We sincerely hope that he will continue his peacemaking efforts.

insights.claim: Ukrainians hope a Democratic Congress will bring more U.S. support for Kyiv but remain focused on concerns at home as winter approaches.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Winter energy-infrastructure stress remains a near-term risk regardless of U.S. politics.

insights.claim: China offered only scripted responses to the midterm results ahead of a prospective Trump-Xi Jinping meeting in Shenzhen later in November, reiterating its aim of a 'constructive relationship of strategic stability.'
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Beijing is protecting the Shenzhen summit; trade-détente expectations remain intact.
insights.quote: build a constructive relationship of strategic stability on the basis of respect, fairness, and reciprocity

insights.claim: North Korea conducted more missile tests the day after the midterms, and Kim Yo Jong said North Korea had 'no need to sit face-to-face' with Trump, signaling disinterest in a Shenzhen meeting with Kim Jong Un.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Trump's weakened standing reduces his diplomatic leverage; Korean peninsula risk persists.

insights.claim: Trump is reportedly considering making Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth the fall guy for Iran war failures, and there are growing signs Hegseth could face a House impeachment vote, though Trump publicly says he intends to keep him.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Pentagon leadership turnover could shift Iran war strategy and defense procurement priorities.
insights.quote: I have every intention to keep him

insights.claim: Former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll, who reportedly left in September over disagreements with Hegseth, has joined OpenAI as senior counselor for national security modernization.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Frontier AI labs are deepening defense ties through senior hires, a signal of growing national-security AI contracts.

themes.theme: Data center backlash at the ballot box

insights.claim: In the 2026 midterms, 41 local ballot measures sought restrictions on data centers, and all but one passed.
insights.speaker: John Haltiwanger, Rishi Iyengar
insights.so_what: Local opposition is a growing siting and permitting risk for AI data center buildouts; watch hyperscaler capex timelines and power-hungry projects.
insights.quote: 41—the number of local ballot measures seeking restrictions on data centers in the midterm elections. All but one of them passed
